authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local Planning Authority dataset contains administrative boundary polygons for each LPA in England and stable entity/reference identifiers. Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA entity/reference/name, local-plan reference/name, local-plan-boundary identifier, LAD identifier/name, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any LPA polygon would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
